ABOUT THE ROLEJoin ERC’s flight test team and contribute to the development and certification of next-generation unmanned aircraft systems. As a Flight Test Engineer, you will contribute directly to the development and certification of our uncrewed heavy-lift VTOL platform. You will be responsible for the planning, execution, and evaluation of ground and flight tests, ensuring safe and compliant operations while generating the data needed to advance our aircraft toward certification.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Plan, prepare, and coordinate aircraft ground and flight test campaigns for development and certification activities
• Act as focal point for test requests from engineering departments and translate them into structured ground and flight test plans
• Categorize test requests and define test objectives, test conditions, and instrumentation requirements in collaboration with relevant stakeholders
• Support the planning, installation, and documentation of flight test instrumentation
• Conduct pre-flight inspections and regular maintenance activities
• Support engineering teams in the manufacturing, integration, test aircraft
• Support weight and balance calculations and measurement activities
• Participate as remote crew member in ground and flight tests by managing and monitoring test sequence execution using telemetry systems from the ground station
• Conduct pre-test briefings and post-test debriefings
• Initiate, coordinate, and track actions to resolve deficiencies and implement recommendations identified during debriefings and in test reports
• Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation, including Flight Test Cards and Flight Test Reports
• Support the continuous development of our Flight Test Organization by improving tools, processes, and methodologies

WHAT YOU BRING
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in aerospace engineering or a comparable discipline
• Professional experience in flight test operations incl. test planning, execution, and data analysis with manned aircraft and/or rotorcraft, or professional experience in the operation of drones and/or model aircraft
• Solid understanding of aircraft systems, flight mechanics, and flight test methodologies
• Hands-on mindset with the ability to work effectively in a dynamic flight test environment
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
• Ability to coordinate across multiple engineering disciplines
• Flexibility and willingness to travel and stay at national and international flight test locations for short- and mid-term campaigns
• Very good verbal and written communication skills in English and German

Nice to have:
• Experience with eVTOL or unmanned aircraft systems
• Knowledge of EASA certification frameworks (e.g., SC-VTOL, SORA)
• Experience with telemetry systems and flight test instrumentation
• Familiarity with data analysis tools (e.g., Python, MATLAB)

WHAT WEC OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

Job Description

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our distributed team of over 100,000 colleagues provides an outstanding mix of brand new technologies, purchasing convenience, and pharmaceutical services across our top-tier brands like Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon, and PPD.

Location/Division Specific Information:

Phadia is the leading supplier of fully automatic blood analysis systems for allergy and auto-immune diseases. With our innovative products, we set standards worldwide and assist clinicians in providing fast and reliable diagnoses, thus helping patients at an early stage. Phadia GmbH in Freiburg is the German subsidiary of the Immunodiagnostics division of Thermo Fisher Scientific, a global company that develops, manufactures and distributes in vitro diagnostics in the field of allergy and autoimmune diagnostics. Our customers expect a consistently reliable and high standard of quality from our products, which we ensure through innovative biochemical and medical technology solutions as well as highly qualified and motivated employees.

A Day in the Life:

- Provide scientific support for the quality control and quality assurance of in vitro diagnostic (IVD) products for autoimmune diseases
- Perform quality control testing of Enzyme immunoassays (EIAs), antigens, raw materials, and reagents as part of routine production and development projects using advanced analytical techniques
- Provide technical guidance and supervision to technical staff
- Participate in projects related to the development and implementation of new products and analytical instruments, including LIMS integration
- Support the transfer of products and test methods from development into routine operations, working closely with colleagues in R&D and Production
- Contribute to projects focused on product lifecycle management and process optimization, including manufacturing and testing procedures as well as production equipment
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives
- Investigate and resolve deviations and customer complaints, and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and continuous improvement measures
- Work with cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues, support regulatory audits, and implement process improvements
- Prepare and review study reports and standard operating procedures (SOPs) in compliance with applicable ISO and GMP requirements

Keys to Success:

- Advanced degree plus some years of experience, or Bachelor's degree plus many years of experience in GMP/GLP regulated laboratory environment
- Preferred Fields of Study: Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Microbiology or related scientific field
- Extensive knowledge in development, production or quality control of Enzyme immunoassays (EIAs)
- Strong understanding of regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, ISO, ICH guidelines)
- Experience with method validation, method transfer, and verification activities
- Proficiency in data analysis, trending, and statistical evaluation
- Demonstrated expertise in laboratory documentation and GMP compliance
- Strong technical writing skills for SOPs, protocols, and investigation reports
- Experience with LIMS and quality management systems
- Proven ability to lead investigations and implement corrective actions
- Excellent project management and organizational skills
- Strong interpersonal skills and ability to mentor staff
- Ability to work independently and as part of cross-functional teams
- Good to excellent proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English

What we offer:

- Employment with an innovative, future-oriented organisation
- Outstanding career and development prospects
- Company pension scheme and other fringe benefits
- Exciting company culture which stands for integrity, intensity, involvement and innovation

If you are interested, please apply online with your CV and Motivation Letter including possible start date.

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Location: Dreieich / Remote, Germany. Territory: Southern Germany (Bavaria and Baden Wuertemberg).
Travel: Approximately 50%.

Discover Impactful Work
We are looking for an Account Manager (m/f/d), Materials & Surface Analysis to drive profitable growth across assigned customers and markets in Southern Germany.

This is a highly dynamic sales role with strong connections to technical, marketing, service and other commercial functions. You will develop strategic customer relationships, understand customer priorities and position Thermo Fisher Scientific solutions to address their scientific and business needs.

The portfolio includes Electron Microscopy (EM), X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS), software, services and related analytical workflows. These core technologies are complemented by adjacent techniques such as Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS), Electron Backscatter Diffraction (EBSD), Raman Spectroscopy, Ion Scattering Spectroscopy (ISS), Electron Energy Loss Spectroscopy (EELS), and others.

A Day in the Life:
You will thrive in this role if you enjoy working in a multidisciplinary, highly technical environment where collaboration, customer engagement and continuous personal development are essential to success.

As part of our Sales and Service organization, you will identify and understand customer needs, develop your market and use your technical expertise and product knowledge to build effective sales strategies. You will create customer presentations, respond to tenders, recommend suitable product solutions and drive opportunities through to successful closure.

Using your technical knowledge and strong interpersonal skills, you will engage effectively with both prospective and existing customers. You will own the full sales cycle—from lead generation and opportunity development through negotiation and closure.

Success in this role requires close collaboration with a broad network of colleagues, including our NanoPort demonstration facilities, product specialists, marketing professionals, fellow Account Managers, service teams and other business functions.

What to expect:

- Develop and strengthen strategic relationships with assigned customers and markets.
- Understand customer priorities and position Thermo Fisher Scientific solutions to create measurable value.
- Own and manage the complete sales cycle from lead identification through closure.
- Identify customer needs, market trends and new business opportunities.
- Apply technical expertise and product knowledge to develop effective sales strategies.
- Prepare and deliver compelling customer presentations and commercial proposals.
- Respond to tenders and recommend the most appropriate product and workflow solutions.
- Build and maintain a healthy opportunity pipeline and accurate sales forecast.
- Collaborate closely with NanoPort colleagues, product specialists, marketing, service teams, peer Account Managers and other business functions.
- Maintain strong CRM and commercial discipline throughout the sales process.
- Travel approximately 50% within the assigned territory.

Keys to Success:
Education

- Typically, an M.Sc. degree or higher in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics or a related scientific or technical field.

Experience

- Demonstrated familiarity with XPS, electron microscopy, spectroscopy, imaging or related analytical instrumentation is required.
- Previous client-facing commercial experience is required.
- Experience working successfully within a matrix organization, with responsibility for clear and effective communication across teams, is highly valuable.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Business-fluent German is required.
- Business-fluent English is required.
- Additional languages are welcome but not essential.
- Proactive, self-motivated and comfortable taking ownership.
- Strong interpersonal skills and an openness to working across cultures and diverse teams.
- Confident communicator in customer meetings, presentations and public-speaking settings.
- Clear, open and effective communication style.
- Ability to develop and maintain strong internal and external customer relationships.
- Ability to articulate how our technologies support materials science applications and create value for customers.
- Strong ability to prioritize requirements and meet or exceed customer expectations.
- Commitment to continuously developing commercial skills and improving sales processes.
- Strong CRM discipline and willingness to work within established business processes.

Benefits:
We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Job Description

The Clinical Diagnostics Division (CDD) provides innovative diagnostic solutions across selected in vitro diagnostics (IVD) market segments and has been a trusted partner to the IVD industry for more than 40 years.

Our portfolio includes solutions for drugs-of-abuse testing, therapeutic drug monitoring, quality control, sepsis diagnosis, prenatal screening and more. Our products and solutions are delivered through direct sales, regional distributors and OEM partnerships.

Location:

Field-based / Remote within the territory - Eastern/ Central Germany
Ideally based in e.g. Halle, Leipzig or Berlin

Discover Impactful Work
Join our Clinical Customer Development team as a Clinical Customer Development Specialist and support the targeted clinical use of Procalcitonin (PCT) and other innovative biomarkers.

In this field-based role, you will lead clinical market development across your territory and increase awareness, acceptance and sustainable adoption of our biomarkers through targeted engagement with healthcare professionals, clinical education and development activities. In doing so, you will support the diagnosis and management of bacterial infections and sepsis, as well as antimicrobial stewardship initiatives, and contribute to advancing biomarker-guided clinical decision-making.

Your focus will be on clinical education, stakeholder engagement and account development, while commercial contracting and sales execution remain with our License Partners.

You will identify the objectives and clinical challenges of healthcare professionals and translate these insights into targeted educational and development activities. This includes supporting the implementation of biomarker-guided clinical pathways, hospital protocols and antimicrobial stewardship programs, as well as delivering clinical education through discussions, presentations and workshops.

What to expect:

- Engage healthcare professionals, clinical users and decision-makers across relevant medical specialties.
- Analyze and prioritize accounts with high clinical development potential, identify relevant stakeholders and develop account-specific strategies to increase clinical acceptance and adoption.
- Build strong, sustainable relationships with key clinical stakeholders and decision-makers.
- Support the implementation of biomarker-guided clinical pathways, hospital protocols and antimicrobial stewardship programs.
- Deliver clinical education through discussions, presentations and workshops.
- Develop account strategies together with our License Partners, align clinical development activities and support joint customer activities where appropriate.
- Act as a scientific and clinical partner and actively drive market development without direct sales responsibility.
- Work closely with Medical Affairs, Marketing and other Commercial teams.
- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at relevant events and scientific congresses.
- Contribute to territory growth through increased clinical adoption and systematic account development.Ensure complete and up-to-date documentation of relevant account and activity information in Salesforce (SFDC).

Keys to Success:
Education

- Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biology or a related scientific field; an advanced scientific or clinical degree is an advantage.

Experience

- 3+ years of relevant experience in healthcare, diagnostics or a related environment.
- Experience in in vitro diagnostics, biomarkers, or clinical areas such as Critical Care, Infectious Diseases, Emergency Medicine, sepsis or Antimicrobial Stewardship is an advantage.
- Experience engaging clinical users and healthcare decision-makers.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Ability to understand and communicate scientific and clinical content.
- Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
- Confident and persuasive engagement with medical decision-makers at different seniority levels, with the ability to conduct credible clinical discussions, constructively challenge established approaches and initiate change.
- Strong analytical and organizational capabilities.

- Ability to work independently and effectively in a cross-functional matrix organization.

Apply Now
Job Title: Senior Researcher in Embedded Research for SAP Autonomous Suite / CX (f/m/d)

Date: 09/07/2026
Company: SAP

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

What you`ll build:

The Academic Partnerships organization at SAP partners with other SAP teams to provide the best services to foster strategic research collaborations between SAP and academia. The PhD Graduate Team is responsible for building the bridge between cutting-edge research and SAP functional teams. Our mission is to facilitate the application of research across SAP and contribute to SAP research strategy with interdisciplinary research activities.

Working together with the SAP Autonomous Suite CX team, focusing on customer satisfaction by increasing the predictability of the semester plans, you will bring perspectives and insights from large-scale agile and software development research to our product delivery planning, enhancing SAP’s strategic position in the Autonomous Suite and the innovation speed, and bridging the gap between industry and academia.

The Role:

In your daily work you will be bridging data science and engineering to turn development data into actionable insights — accelerating team flow, predictability, and customer satisfaction across SAP Commerce release cycles, collaborating with industry experts, researchers, and business stakeholders.

The position involves working within a highly motivated team of experts, driving innovation in a collaborative research environment , with close collaboration across lines of business and strong potential to influence future product directions and innovation at scale .

- Design and maintain a Commerce-wide engineering metrics framework to track delivery health and team performance
- Review metrics health at team, product, and portfolio level to surface bottlenecks and delivery risks early
- Embed retrospective learnings into process standards, creating a continuous improvement loop across Commerce teams
- Pilot AI-assisted tooling to improve planning accuracy, effort estimation, and workflow automation
- Share engineering excellence practices across squads and teams to accelerate adoption of predictable delivery patterns
- Bridge the gap between academic findings and industry
- Participate in interdisciplinary research activities with the PhD graduate team, supporting SAP’s research strategy
- Be an active part of research mentoring programs and the research community at SAP
- Collaborate with various internal and external stakeholders

What you bring:

- Advanced degree (PhD preferred) in Computer Science or Information Systems, with a research focus on large-scale agile development, engineering metrics, or communities of practice in software organizations
- Research background (publications preferred) in the field of innovation (incl. AI adoption) in software development models, scrum, agile, adoption or other development models
- Proven track record of applied industry-academic research related to agile contexts (conferences like IEEE CBI, publications preferred)
- Experience leading research projects and delivering data-driven recommendations in collaboration with industry partners
- Hands-on technical skills including data analysis, LLM and AI-assisted prototyping, and working with engineering telemetry data (e.g. Jira) to generate delivery insights, programming skills preferred (python, Java, JavaScript)
- Demonstrated ability to manage industry-academic partnerships and multi-stakeholder initiatives, and co-organizing large-scale events
- Ability to work on challenging research topics with a structured, scientific approach
- Sound understanding of SAP’s product strategy and the Autonomous Enterprise
- Experience integrating AI assistants in workflows, incl. quality assurance.
- Strong hands-on mindset and willingness to translate promising research direction into product functionality
- Strong collaboration skills and a team-oriented mindset
- Good written and verbal communication skills in English, German is a plus

Where you belong:

The Academic Partnership organization at SAP is the bridge connecting SAP and academia. We build collaborative, structured partnerships with academic institutions and encompass a wide range of activities and programs in regards of academic teaching, academic community management, and PhD talent management.

The PhD Graduate Team stands for embedding cutting-edge research into functional teams across SAP, bringing together interdisciplinary PhD talent in a research-like environment.

Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. As our IT Architecture & Infrastructure Lead, you will play a key role in shaping and advancing Coriolis Pharma’s global technology landscape. Working closely with internal stakeholders, external technology partners, and global leadership, you will help build a modern and future-ready IT environment that enables business growth, innovation, and operational excellence. EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring
learning and belonging to every child. Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19
countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance,
belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be

Ability to build credibility and earn trust from C-suite to school

What you’ll do

- Lead by exampleand continuously raise the bar for photographic quality and execution across the Studio
- Execute and oversee food, product, lifestyle, and marketing photography to the highest commercial standards
- Coach, mentor, and support photographersthrough feedback, knowledge sharing, and hands-on guidance to elevate overall team capability

- Work together with Studio leadership to improve production quality, studio efficiency, and scalable ways of working
- Collaborateclosely with Art Direction, Styling, Culinary, Post-production, and Creative teams to ensure strong and consistent visual execution

- Drive consistencyacross large asset volumes while maintaining visual excellence and operational efficiency
- Actively contribute to Studio and company AI initiativesby supporting experimentation, developing practical use cases, and helping integrate AI-supported and hybrid content creation workflows

- You demonstrate exceptional photography craft and technical excellence. Providing a portfolio is mandatory
- You have deep expertise in lighting, composition, camera systems, color, production environments, and visual storytelling
- You have experience operating in fast-paced production environments and collaborating across multiple disciplines and stakeholders
- You naturally elevate others through coaching, feedback, mentorship, and sharing best practices
